title: US basketball player arrested with 75lb of marijuana at Nigerian airport, say authorities
summary_full: Suspect named as Greene Da’monte KhireeDrug smuggling carries life sentence in NigeriaAn American basketball player has been arrested in Nigeria for allegedly attempting to smuggle 33.95kg (75lb) of marijuana into the country.Nigeria’s National Drug Law Enforcement Agency (NDLEA) said a 28-year-old player named as Greene Da’monte Khiree from the state of Georgia was arrested at Lagos’s main airport last Wednesday after he arrived on a flight from Thailand via the United Arab Emirates.
